title: SQL parity
label: SQL parity
checked: SqlTable pipelines on SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL against the same pipelines on a DataFrame: verbs, row order, window functions, joins, byte-order text, boolean aggregates, edge-case arithmetic, and driver column types.
description: Each test runs a pipeline as SQL, collects the result, and compares it with the DataFrame result or a fixed expectation.
inputs: Inline SELECT ... UNION ALL data in tests/SqlTest.php, tests/SqlReviewTest.php, and tests/DriverTypesTest.php; temporary tables only.

comparison.applies_to: Rows, row order, types, generated SQL, or exception class; doubles rounded to 9 decimal places

known_differences: MySQL stores no Inf or NaN, and SQLite stores no NaN. These values return as NA and are compared as NA.
Joins do not warn about unexpected many-to-many matches.
reproduce: PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL="pgsql:host=127.0.0.1;port=5432;dbname=postgres" PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL_USER=postgres PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL="mysql:host=127.0.0.1;port=3306" PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL_USER=root php vendor/bin/pest tests/SqlTest.php tests/SqlReviewTest.php tests/DriverTypesTest.php
